$comment: A completed pass. Pins three things that are easy to lose: a pass is charged when it STARTS; the receipt carries the cursor watermarks the checkpoint was taken at (without them a restore replays work); and a check that did not run is not a zero.

desk.title: Scope read policies to project membership

assertions: charged is true and chargedAt is startedAt, not endedAt — the pass is spend, not outcome
a restore from this receipt replays no consumed event and no cursor
a check with ran=false has ok=null and renders as not looked at, never as passing or failing
journal.sha256 matches the file the restore reads, or the receipt is refused (divergent.json)
